## Optometry

[Envision Optical](http://envisionoptical.com.au/) are passionate about caring for their patient's eyes to ensure clear vision to enhance their ability to do the things they love. Owner and Optometrist Andrew Bowden believes in providing personalised care focused on a preventative approach for patients of all ages.

**SERVICES INCLUDE**

- Complete visual and eye health examination

- Childrens visual and eye health examination

- Contact lens assessment and fitting including complex cases such as keratoconus

- Ortho-K Vision Correction Therapy

- Diagnosis and treatment of Dry eyes including IPL and LIPIFLOW therapy

- Myopia Control Therapy

- Diagnosis and treatment of red eyes

- Glaucoma assessment

- Diabetes eye health screenings

- Cataract assessment

- Macular Degeneration assessment

- OCT Nerve and Retina Scanning

- Digital Retinal Photography

- Computer Vision assessment

- Colour vision assessment

- Workplace Eye Safety

- Comprehensive Low Vision Assessment

- Drivers Licence vision screenings including heavy vehicle

- Veterans affairs consultations

## High-Quality Optical Services

Welcome to EyeMax EyeCare!

Maintaining clear and comfortable vision plays an important role in everyday life, from reading and working to enjoying time with family. At EyeMax EyeCare in Wallsend, patients receive guidance and support from an experienced team led by a licensed optical dispenser who has provided optical services in the Hunter Region since 2008.

With comprehensive[eye examinations](https://www.eyemaxeyecare.com.au/eye-tests), prescription checks,[retinal imaging](https://www.eyemaxeyecare.com.au/digital-retinal-photography)and a wide range of[eyewear options](https://www.eyemaxeyecare.com.au/glasses), EyeMax EyeCare offers an approachable environment for patients seeking ongoing vision care. The practice also partners with Australian lens laboratories, ensuring access to high-quality, locally produced[lenses](https://www.eyemaxeyecare.com.au/prescription-lenses)tailored to each prescription.

EyeMax EyeCare continues to support patients from across Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Maitland, Cessnock and Singleton, with a focus on clarity, comfort and long-term ocular health. Each appointment is approached with care, allowing time for assessment, explanation and tailored recommendations that suit lifestyle and visual needs. ## About Our Optical Services & Eye Wear

EyeMax EyeCare is an independently owned and operated optical business run by Optical Dispenser Max Guernier for 15 years located in the heart of Wallsend.

Our Optometrists use advanced technology to skilfully check both the health of your eyes and your **prescription**. We take care in providing comfort as well as thorough **30-minute consultations** to ensure the early detection of eye health concerns and diseases.

At EyeMax EyeCare, our friendly staff will assure you are getting the correct **glasses** and **lenses** that best suit you and your needs. We carry a wide range of unique brands and styles to make sure there is something for everyone to enjoy.

Our in-house assembly and fitting by Max means you’ll benefit from the highest quality and attention to detail that can be offered. Max checks each **pair of glasses** taking care and time to assure that your **glasses** are correctly made to your **prescription**.

Looking forward to helping you with your **eye health** and **eyewear needs**.

[Learn More](https://www.eyemaxeyecare.com.au/contact)

## Supportive & Stylish Eyewear

At EyeMax EyeCare in Wallsend we offer a wide range of functional and fashionable frames designed to support different prescriptions, face shapes and day-to-day needs. We understand that choosing eyewear involves more than selecting a style, which is why we focus on helping you find frames that feel comfortable, fit securely and work well with your prescription. Our collection includes classic, contemporary and statement designs so you can explore options that suit your personal taste while also meeting your practical requirements.

With more than 1000 frames available, we provide choices ranging from subtle and refined styles to bold and modern shapes. Our team of optical dispensers guide you through materials, sizes and design features so your frames match your lifestyle and how you use your glasses each day. We also stock exclusive and unique eyewear brands as well as budget-friendly options that still provide reliable comfort and durability. No matter what you prefer, we take the time to understand what you are looking for and help you narrow down frames that fit well and feel right for you.﻿

We have a lineage of eye care spanning many decades. Always thorough, always friendly, and always offering the best value. Our optometrists, Jack Crawford & Eva Woodward, offer an unbeatable combination of experience & professional knowledge.

## Professional Eye Care

We offer full-scope professional optometry services, including complex contact lens fittings & therapeutic treatment of red eye etc. We use only top quality spectacle lenses & our frame selection is varied, with many offerings unique to the practice.

## Precision Prescribing

Optometry is many things: disease detection, treatment, and offering professional advice. It is also about prescribing with precision; our thorough approach to this matter is beyond question.

## Quality Eye Wear & Contact Lenses

We offer a full range of high-quality fashionable spectacle frames, and we source lenses only from the best of suppliers. We work hard to meet your budget. Contact lens fitting is one of our specialties and we keep up-to-date with the latest technologies.

We pride ourselves on our knowledge in this ever-changing market, and you can trust our advice. We can source & supply "wrapped" (highly curved) lenses, polarised, photochromic options & mirror coatings.
